name: Rent Manager
description: Rent Manager is property-management software from London Computer Systems covering accounting, reporting, marketing and leasing, work orders, mobile workflows, tenant and owner portals, e-signatures, and an integration ecosystem.
best_for: Property management companies that want a customizable property database with integrated accounting, leasing, work orders, portals, and a large integration ecosystem.
features: Marketing, online applications, leasing, renewals, and built-in e-signatures
Owner, prospect, and tenant portals plus resident mobile tools
Custom fields, workflows, reports, and dashboards
API, Open Access data views, and 200+ integrated providers

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Quote-based bundle with accounting, reporting, work orders, marketing/leasing, applications/eSignatures, portals, and support.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Quote-based bundle adding vendor management, custom workflows, survey analytics, mobile app capabilities, and more.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Quote-based bundle adding advanced AI-assisted accounting/reporting, video inspections, maintenance scheduling, and dedicated success support.

pros: Highly customizable workflows, fields, dashboards, and integrations
Accounting, leasing, maintenance, and portals live in one system
API and Open Access options support custom integrations and reporting
cons: Customization depth can require more implementation work than simpler tools
Some communication and AI capabilities depend on add-on services

alternatives.name: Buildium
alternatives.description: Property management software for rental accounting, leasing, and maintenance.
alternatives.best_for: Property managers wanting a more standardized cloud workflow.

alternatives.name: AppFolio
alternatives.description: Property management software covering leasing, accounting, maintenance, and resident operations.
alternatives.best_for: Managers wanting another broad all-in-one platform.

alternatives.name: Yardi Breeze
alternatives.description: Cloud property-management software with published per-unit pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller portfolios prioritizing simple pricing and quick cloud access.
